prompt: Review an unseen multi-engine lakehouse packet. Design and defend catalog authority, table format and storage ownership, snapshot/manifest/file correctness, schema/partition/format evolution, Trino query planning and workload policy, concurrent commits, maintenance, retention, privacy, recovery, capacity and cost; recover one injected incident; then revise the design after the reviewer changes a major compatibility, scale, workload, retention, privacy or cost constraint.
deliverables: Consumer decisions, SLIs, identities, authorities and complete data/metadata copy map.
Read path from SQL identity through plan/stages/tasks/connector/catalog/snapshot/manifests/files to result.
Write path from operation/base snapshot through candidate files, conflict validation, atomic commit, acknowledgement and reconciliation.
Reader/writer/connector/catalog compatibility matrix for schema field IDs, partition/sort specs and format features.
Query-plan diagnosis using planning and bounded runtime evidence, pruning, files/splits, skew, exchanges and dependencies.
Measured small-file/delete/manifest debt and bounded compaction/manifest strategy with logical equivalence.
Snapshot/reference, rollback/time-travel, backup, orphan and privacy lifecycle with deletion safeguards.
Workload isolation, least privilege, transport/storage protection, metrics, audit and lineage.
Capacity, debt/drain/recovery and unit-cost calculations at the actual bottleneck.
Incident timeline, containment, supported rollback/forward repair, consumer proof, changed-constraint defense and exact cleanup.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar sanitized catalog/table/snapshot/manifest/file, plan/runtime, compatibility, workload, policy and cost evidence.
No shared service, real credential, customer data, host network/clock mutation, unbounded query/rewrite/delete or unknown cleanup.
Current table state is resolved from catalog authority and complete metadata closure, never inferred from directory listing.
Commit ambiguity is reconciled through operation/base/candidate/snapshot evidence before retry or cleanup.
Every active reader/writer/tool is checked against field/spec/format features and rollback path.
EXPLAIN is separated from executing EXPLAIN ANALYZE and all runtime probes are bounded and authorized.
Maintenance has measured trigger, scope, spare capacity, conflict handling, equivalence proof, rollback and cost evidence.
Retention protects active writers/references and reconciles recovery, legal/audit and privacy requirements.
Query/table/consumer evidence connects identities without leaking sensitive values.
Reviewer observes recovery, changed-constraint revision, delayed explanation and exact teardown.
